newsitems.title: Check out what's coming to Cyberpunk 2077 in the Edgerunners 2 Update!
newsitems.author: Vattier
newsitems.contents: [p]Thought you were done with Night City? Well, Night City's not quite done with you![/p][p][/p][p]Patch notes for Cyberpunk 2077's Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) are now available for your early perusal before the update hits the streets on October 22nd. Watch the Features Overview video to see some of the new features in action:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uMzXH1QJx6M;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]And if you want to know even more, read through the list of most important changes below:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Edgerunners Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a new side quest, [i]Clampdown[/i], set before the events of [i]Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2[/i]. To unlock it, complete [i]The Heist [/i]and two gigs for Wakako, then wait for a message from her.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new 5-piece gear set based on the character King, which can be obtained during the [i]Clampdown [/i]side quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new radio station, HKGN 102.0 FM, featuring a selection of tracks from the [i]Cyberpunk: Edgerunners[/i] series.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Show Off[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A brand-new clothing collection has arrived in Night City! 5 new outfit sets can now be purchased from certain clothing vendors:[/p][list][*][p]Maxiwear: available in Heywood, Arroyo, Little China[/p][/*][*][p]Jinguji: available in City Center[/p][/*][*][p]NetWatch: available in Kabuki, Japantown[/p][/*][*][p]IconAmerica: available in Pacifica, Badlands, Northside[/p][/*][*][p]And one more set that will hit Night City shelves just a little later...[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The NUS Infiltrator clothing set can be now purchased from clothing vendors in Kabuki and Japantown.[/p][/*][*][p]4 new TWINTONE skins for Quadra Turbo-R V-Tech are now available via Twitch Drops.[/p][/*][*][p]Some of the hairstyles that were previously exclusive to NPCs are now available for V. Please note that some hairstyles are available only to feminine or masculine body types.[/p][/*][*][p]Show off your chrome! You can now customize your hand cyberware. Equip your Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire or Projectile Launch System, and visit one of 5 Glamdocs (marked with a spray paint icon on the map) to give your implants a fresh, new look. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable colors.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes one gun just isn't enough. The new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree (along with four auxiliary perks) introduces an entirely new playstyle, allowing you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category.[/p][/*][*][p]Added frames from the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game to Photo Mode, allowing you to make your preem shots look like custom cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new poses in Photo Mode to show off your dual-wielding prowess.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Mod the World[/b][/h3][p]Added Cross-Platform Mod Support, powered by mod.io, a first step into cross-platform modding that allows you to easily browse and install a selection of player-created mods directly from the in-game menu. More mods will become available over time. The feature is available on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Upgrading the World[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]Welcome to Paradise[/i]! Added a new side quest that takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night. It unlocks after completing [i]The Heist[/i] and reaching level 15 Street Cred.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 12 new Minor Arcana Tarot Cards to discover across Night City. The Tarot menu now has separate sections for Major and Minor Arcana. The new tarot cards are part of a new side quest, an extension of [i]Fool on the Hill[/i], which activates after scanning any of the new cards. Collect them all to get a special reward.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Saves in the “Load Game” menu are now grouped by separate playthroughs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added item filters to apartment and vehicle stashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Modded saves in the "Load Game" menu are now marked with a dedicated icon. Please note that achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing on console from a modded save file.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the selection of AMD FSR options. FSR 3 upscaling is no longer included, while FSR 2.1, FSR 4, and FSR 3.1 Frame Generation remain available.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the CD PROJEKT RED Account connection, My Rewards and telemetry consent menus.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Technology[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for glasses-free 3D effects on compatible Samsung Odyssey 3D monitors, along with a Motion Comfort setting that lets you balance 3D depth and viewing comfort.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for MetalFX Frame Interpolation on Mac.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a toggle in settings for FSR Anti-Lag 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced various performance optimizations, including improvements specifically for Ray Tracing.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved HDR rendering to provide more accurate colors, brightness, and contrast on compatible displays.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]Things Done Changed[/i]- Fixed an issue where the Delamain cab could get stuck after crashing into another vehicle, blocking quest progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enabling Film Grain had no effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where tagging enemies while scanning could also cause V to crouch or stand up when using certain control schemes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where controller settings for the Third-Person Camera were missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several typos in various languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Added various other fixes for features and content introduced since Patch 2.1.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Update 2.1 Patch Notes
newsitems.author: Vattier
newsitems.contents:
Update 2.1 for Cyberpunk 2077 and Phantom Liberty is coming out tomorrow (December 5th) around 12 PM CET.

The update brings our usual bug fixes, changes and gameplay improvements. It also adds some of the most-requested features, such as metro, radioport, repeatable car races, hangouts with love interests, cats, and more! 

In preparation for the update's release tomorrow, check out the list of changes below. 


[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] V's issue with their NCART City Pass is resolved and they can now travel between the 19 metro stations located throughout Night City on 5 different lines via fast travel or riding the train itself while gazing out the window and watching the world go by.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210272/14b453c93542ffcbede4119b39707a058d5df3a7.gif[/img]
[*] V will now be able to invite their love interest to spend some time together in any of the apartments. Hangouts are a repeatable, unlimited event that become available once the romance path with a given character has concluded.
[*] You can now listen to the radio while on foot (or while riding the NCART train) using the new Radioport feature. Available while you explore, it switches seamlessly to car radio whenever you get in a vehicle and turns off when quest-specific music starts playing. It is now also possible to adjust volume directly in the radio window.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210272/f003199e9d8e9c2d3cf1867e1d2ed3142a281c67.gif[/img]
[*] Added replayable car races V can take part in after finishing The Beast in Me. Look for race flag icons on the map and win the races to get eddies and a discount for the Autofixer website. Additionally, we improved the racers' AI to make them more competitive and made enhancements so that the whole experience is much more fun!
[*] Sightseeing binoculars in various scenic spots have been added as another way to appreciate Night City's vistas.
[/list]

[h2]Accessibility[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can find out more about the Accessibility features available in the game in [url=https://www.cyberpunk.net/en/news/49591/update-2-1-accessibility-features]this article[/url].
[*] Added an option to enable a bigger interface font.
[*] You can now disable the timer in the Breach Protocol minigame.
[*] Added more customization options for the HUD:
[list][*] Larger HUD elements.
[*] Removed HUD Lens Distortion (the curved effect on the HUD).
[*] Removed HUD Visual Effects (the "ghosting" effect on the HUD).
[*] Reduced HUD Decorative Elements to improve clarity.
[/list][*] Added a new Accessibility tab, moved the Difficulty and Subtitles settings and some of the Controls and Interface options.
[*] Added a "Weapon Cycling to Arm Cyberware" setting, which allows to enable or disable cycling arm cyberware when cycling through equipped weapons.
[*] UI panel's Up/Down and Left/Right keys are now rebindable to adapt to AZERTY and QWERTZ keyboards.
[/list]

[h2]Quests & Open World[/h2]
[list]
[*] V can now be pursued by gangs after taking an aggressive approach towards them during certain gigs and main quests.
[*] Gigs that involve stealing and delivering a vehicle can now turn into a car chase and a combat sequence.
[*] Decorative vendors spawned inside some kiosks are now functional. Please note that food stands are not impacted by this change.
[*] It is now possible to sit at various bars in Night City and interact with the vendors.
[*] Fixed an issue where some gigs wouldn't trigger after approaching the quest area.
[*] [i]Chippin' In[/i] - Fixed an issue where Rogue would follow V around permanently.
[*] [i]Cyberpsycho Sighting: House on a Hill[/i] - Fixed an issue where Peter Greene's body was still highlighted after scanning.
[*] [i]Every Grain of Sand[/i] - Fixed an issue where the reward vehicle for completing all Badlands gigs did not spawn.
[*] [i]Gas Gas Gas[/i] - Fixed an issue where the reward vehicle for completing all City Center gigs did not spawn.
[*] [i]Gig: Olive Branch[/i] - Fixed an issue where it was not possible to talk to Sergei Karasinsky because he did not spawn.
[*] [i]Killing in the Name[/i] - Fixed an issue where it was not possible to progress past the "Go to the signal's source" objective because the conversation with Johnny did not trigger.
[*] [i]Life During Wartime[/i] - Fixed an issue where Panam would not get on the motorcycle when required to follow her to the gas station.
[*] [i]Space Oddity[/i] - Fixed an issue where the quest did not activate even after updating the game to Patch 2.01.
[*] [i]The Prophet's Song[/i] - Fixed an issue where the quest could reappear as "Undiscovered" on the map.
[/list]

[h2]Phantom Liberty-specific[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies in some Suspected Organized Crime Activities in Dogtown did not spawn, blocking progress.
[*] Fixed an issue where in-game time would not pass after watching the braindance from Lizzy Wizzy's concert. It is required to use the Skip Time option for the fix to take effect.
[*] Fixed an issue where [i]Arachnophobia[/i] and [i]All the President's Men[/i] achievements were not granted despite meeting the requirements.
[*] The [i]Relic Ruler[/i] achievement will no longer unlock after acquiring only one Relic Perk. Please note that this fix will not reset an already unlocked achievement.
[*] Previously exclusive Iconic weapons are now obtainable in the game.
[*] Alabai, Borzaya, Laika, Taigan and Volkodav Iconic weapons will now be available for purchase from the Black Market Vendor if they were not retrieved from an Airdrop.
[*] [i]Addicted to Chaos[/i] - Fixed an issue where the quest would complete automatically without actually finishing it.
[*] [i]Addicted to Chaos[/i] - Fixed an issue where the garage door would not open after entering the code.
[*] [i]Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos[/i] - Fixed an issue where Mr. Hands would not answer when called.
[*] [i]From Her to Eternity[/i] - Fixed an issue where it was not possible to place the metal pin on the table in V's apartment.
[*] [i]Get It Together[/i] - Fixed an issue where it was not possible to enter the Heavy Hearts club.
[*] [i]Hi Ho Silver Lining[/i] - Fixed an issue where it was not possible to talk to Mr. Hands in the Heavy Hearts club because he wasn't interactable or did not spawn.
[*] [i]Lucretia My Reflection[/i] - Fixed an issue where the player could be stuck in a permanent holocall with Songbird after leaving the abandoned apartment.
[*] [i]Lucretia My Reflection[/i] - Fixed an issue where Reed would not call after waiting two days.
[*] [i]Somewhat Damaged[/i] - Fixed an issue that could cause the player to get stuck in a crouching position, making it impossible to connect to the port in the core.
[*] [i]Somewhat Damaged[/i] - Fixed an issue where sprinting or jumping was permanently disabled after riding the elevator.
[*] [i]Things Done Changed[/i] - Fixed an issue where the screen could go black after calling the nurse for players who still experienced this issue on Patch 2.02.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the boss fights with Yasha Ivanov, Boris Ribakov and Adam Smasher. Smasher will now be able to activate Sandevistan.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210272/7cdb7d0a059c18b226d788140a9db8a88beee2e8.gif[/img]
[*] Added new Cyberware: [b]Feen-X[/b] and [b]Cogito Lattice[/b].
[list][*] [b]Feen-X: Skeleton Cyberware[/b]
Cyberware Capacity cost: 16
Armor: 8/14/20/26/31
+250% RAM Regen Rate when available RAM is below 3/4/5/6/7
[*] [b]Cogito Lattice: Integumentary System Cyberware[/b]
Cyberware Capacity cost: 12
Armor: 18/27/36/45/54
+200%/210%/220%/230%/240% Armor from this cyberware when available RAM is below 2/4/6/8/10
[/list][*] Rebalanced stats of multiple cyberware:
[list][*] [b]Adreno-Trigger[/b]: Decreased movement speed bonus duration.
[*] [b]All Berserks (except Militech Berserk)[/b]: Added a damage reduction bonus.
[*] [b]Axolotl[/b]: Decreased Cooldown reduction.
[*] [b]Camillo RAM Manager[/b]: Decreased Cooldown.
[*] [b]Chrome Compressor[/b]: Increased the Cyberware Capacity bonus, lowered the price.
[*] [b]Dense Marrow[/b]: Decreased Armor, increased melee Stamina cost.
[*] [b]Epimorphic Skeleton[/b]: Decreased Armor.
[*] [b]Ex-Disk[/b]: Increased quickhack upload speed bonus.
[*] [b]Leeroy Ligament System[/b]: Increased Armor.
[*] [b]Lynx Paws[/b]: Added 20% damage reduction from falls.
[*] [b]Microgenerator[/b]: Decreased Electrical damage.
[*] [b]Militech "Apogee" Sandevistan[/b]: Decreased the extended duration bonus, decreased Max Duration, increased headshot damage, increased Crit Chance and Crit Damage.
[*] [b]Militech "Falcon" Sandevistan[/b]: Decreased the extended duration bonus, increased Max Duration, increased Health bonus after neutralizing an enemy.
[*] [b]Nano-Plating[/b]: Changed Attunement from Cool to Reflex (Crit Chance bonus).
[*] [b]Peripheral Inverse[/b]: Increased Armor.
[*] [b]RAM Reallocator[/b]: Increased recovered Max RAM.
[*] [b]RAM Upgrade[/b]: Increased RAM recovery rate.
[*] [b]Reinforced Tendons[/b]: Decreased Armor.
[*] [b]Self-ICE[/b]: Decreased Cooldown.
[*] [b]Shock-N-Awe[/b]: Changed Attunement bonus to Tech weapon damage.
[*] [b]Universal Booster[/b]: Health Item effects will now stack.
[/list][*] Decreased Cyberware Capacity cost for: [b]Memory Boost, Bioconductor, Kerenzikov Boost System, Rara Avis, Reflex Tuner, Defenzikov, Cellular Adapter, Handle Wrap, Axolotl, Microgenerator, Peripheral Inverse, Leeroy Ligament System, Camillo RAM Manager[/b].
[*] Balance changes for some of the perks:
[list][*] [b]Spontaneous Obliteration[/b]: Changed -15% recoil to +12.5% Crit Chance for Level 1.
[*] [b]Die! Die! Die![/b]: Changed -15% recoil to +12.5% Crit Chance for Level 1, added a bonus where weapon handling improves as Stamina decreases for Level 2.
[*] [b]Sharpshooter[/b]: Added a Stamina cost bonus on top of the existing Stamina Regen Rate bonus for Level 3.
[*] [b]Shoot to Chill[/b]: -7% Stamina cost replaced by +4% Armor penetration.
[/list][*] Made balance tweaks for some of the weapons:
[list][*] [b]Electric Baton[/b]: Electric Batons Alpha, Gamma and Beta now have slightly differing stats. They can now hit multiple enemies at the same time. Base damage has been reduced by 7.5%.
[*] [b]M2067 Defender, MA70 HB[/b]: Adjusted recoil patterns.
[*] [b]DR-12 Quasar[/b]: Increased damage by 8%, Headshot Damage Multiplier increased from +150% to +175%.
[*] [b]HA-4 Grit[/b]: Increased damage by 10%, Headshot Damage Multiplier decreased from +150% to +125%.
[*] [b]L-69 Zhuo[/b]: Increased damage by 6%.
[*] [b]DB-4 Palica[/b]: Increased damage by 9%.
[*] [b]Tech weapons which fire in full auto when fully charged (Senkoh LX, DR-12 Quasar, HA-4 Grit)[/b]: They will now be more stable and do roughly +15% more damage when the charge mode is active.
[/list][*] Crafted weapons can now have up to two mod slots. Please note that this change won’t affect weapons crafted prior to this patch.
[*] Increased the rate at which mods drop from enemies. Added a chance for weapon mods to appear in containers that previously offered only Crafting Components.
[*] Increased the availability of mods in weapon vendors' stock, Pax mod will be always available. 
[*] It will be now possible to properly install Tech weapon mods instead of Power weapon mods on the HA-4 Grit.
[*] Tier 4 and Tier 5 weapon mods can now be found in weapon vendors' stock (if player's Tier is high enough).
[*] Increased the max ammo limit you can carry in your inventory for all ammo types.
[*] Crafted Iconic weapons will now be properly displayed when put in the stash.
[*] Cyberware Capacity Shards should now drop properly for players who have reached max level.
[*] Fixed an issue where some Tier 5+ weapons and cyberware were upgraded to Tier 5+ again or to a lower tier.
[*] It will now be possible to activate Overclock while controlling cameras.
[*] Kerenzikov will now work with throwable weapons.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [i]V for Vendetta[/i] achievement would unlock despite not meeting the requirements. Please note that this fix will not reset an already unlocked achievement.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player didn't receive [i]The Quick and the Dead[/i] achievement despite meeting the requirements.
[*] Reduced the minimum stick tilt angle required to stay in sprint when playing on a controller.
[*] Secondary stats in cyberware changed via the "Chipware Connoisseur" perk will no longer have their values randomized after saving or loading.
[*] After reaching level 60 in the Netrunner skill, the Overclock ability will now properly reveal the enemies within 10m and allow you to hack them through cover.
[*] Adjusted the Synapse Burnout quickhack. Decreased the max damage bonus from +400% to +300% for Tiers 3-5. Decreased the max damage bonus from +600% to +400% and lowered the bonus per RAM unit from 12% to 10% for the Iconic variant.
[*] Made player movement smoother and more responsive:
[list][*] V can now start sprinting immediately after shooting rather than after a delay.
[*] Fixed an issue where sprinting with held input was canceled by jumping, falling and other actions that don't cancel toggled sprinting.
[*] If V jumps while sprinting, sprint will now resume upon landing even if V was shooting while in the air (but not at the moment of landing). Also works for aiming, scanning and using melee weapons.
[*] Fixed several issues with the "Multitasker" perk: sprint couldn’t be started while already shooting; sprint was cancelled by jumping, dodging/dashing or running out of Stamina; weapons were rapidly going in and out of the sprinting position (held closer to the chest).
[*] Fixed an issue with the "Ninjutsu" perk where crouch sprinting couldn’t be activated with the hold crouch input.
[*] During a slide with the "Ninjutsu" perk, pressing sprint or dodging/dashing will now make V crouch-sprint.
[*] Sprinting "area" on controller sticks increased slightly to prevent accidentally stopping sprint.
[*] Fixed an issue where sprint couldn’t be toggled during dodge/dash.
[*] Dash slide! Pressing crouch during dodge/dash from a standing position makes V either slide (for forward dashes only) or crouch.
[*] Dodge/dash during slide is now performed in the correct direction based on camera instead of the slide path, but can no longer be backwards or sideways - slide is canceled instead.
[*] Slide direction can now be adjusted slightly sideways with directional inputs.
[*] Slide can now be more consistently performed during a diagonal sprint.
[*] Sliding can now be properly canceled with backward directional input.
[*] Automatic vaulting during dash will no longer happen for backwards or sideways dashes. Regular vaulting with jump input is still possible in any direction.
[*] Automatic climbing during dash will no longer happen if directional input isn't held.
[*] Automatic vaulting and climbing during dash should now be more consistent.
[*] Fixed an issue where shooting was blocked while falling after an air dash.
[*] Double tap dodge/dash can now be performed while another directional input on keyboard is held (resulting in a diagonal dodge/dash).
[*] Fixed an issue where sprint was canceled by double-tap dodge/dash.
[*] Fixed an issue where slides did not fully execute when playing with the Dynamic Control Scheme on a controller.
[/list][*] After crafting an item with the Active Chimera Core or Cerberus's Decoded Behavioral System Component, the crafting specs requiring will disappear from the Crafting panel.
[*] Players who completed all of Regina's gigs prior to Update 2.0 will have the Neofiber cyberware they received as a reward replaced with Axolotl.
[*] Stats from arm cyberware will now be applied correctly regardless if they are drawn or not.
[*] Fixed an issue where V's HP wouldn't drop below 25% due to BioDyne Berserks's effect remaining active permanently. Please note that this fix is not retroactive, as it won't affect cases where this issue already occurred prior to 2.1.
[/list]

[h2]Vehicles & Traffic[/h2]
[list]
[*] Opened the previously closed off highway that spans Westbrook, Santo Domingo and Heywood.
[*] It is now possible to lean while riding bikes. Use LShft/LCtrl on keyboard or Left Stick on a gamepad to make the rider lean - Up to lean forward, or Down to lean back. Leaning only changes your Center of Mass. Lean back and apply the gas to do a wheelie, lean forward and apply the brake to do an endo. Changing your Center of Mass changes how much traction you have at either end. Lean forward a little mid corner to induce oversteer, lean a little back to induce understeer. In the air, lean forward/backward to do flips, steer to do spins!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210272/44091cb46015a6cb8ed9e109f2b6538b89526c74.gif[/img]
[*] Added 5 new bikes to purchase from the Autofixer website.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210272/f7aef5ff4a6a735301fca8fc1addf11b038c6ef7.jpg[/img]
[*] Added a new car - the Porsche 911 Cabriolet. Visit the Autofixer website for more details.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210272/d475d29b6b9396ab0f067101248f58520248da25.png[/img]
[*] Added an option to mark vehicles as Favorite in the Call Vehicle menu.
[*] Added an option to throw knives and axes while riding bikes.
[*] Improved the melee animations when driving bikes in third person perspective.
[*] Attacking an NPC driver will now cause their vehicle to swerve.
[/list]

[h2]Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] Overhauled sound effects in scenes in the base game's main, side and minor quests.
[*] Authoring and up-mixing of scenes to the Surround Sound format.
[*] Added missing sound effects.
[*] Fixed missing post-processing for voices.
[*] Improvements to gun and combat sound effects.
[*] Improvements to vehicle audio.
[*] Various sound fixes.
[*] Panam will no longer sound as if she's in a holocall when talking to her about events from Phantom Liberty in person.
[/list]

[h2]Visual[/h2]
[list]
[*] Various lighting improvements around the city.
[*] Improved the visuals of Kiroshi scanner highlights.
[*] Changed the appearance of the Blackwall in [i]Transmission[/i] to match its appearance in Phantom Liberty.
[*] Fixed an issue where there could be a cigarette permanently attached to V's hand.
[*] The flame will now be properly aligned with exhaust pipes on the Yaiba Kusanagi CT-3X.
[*] Electroshock VFX released by Microgenerator will now have VFX when playing without Phantom Liberty.
[*] Fixed some instances where the animations after installing cyberware at Ripperdocs would not trigger.
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an option to mark weapons as Favorite, so that selling, disassembling or dropping them is locked.
[*] Changed how Resolution Scaling modes are presented in Graphics Settings. Added a toggle to switch between DLSS Super Resolution, AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 2.1 and Intel Xe Super Sampling 1.2. Depending on your selection you can customize other options, e.g. enable Dynamic Resolution Scaling.
[*] Added a tooltip describing how to gain XP in each skill in the Skill Progression panel.
[*] Attempting to attack or shoot in areas where combat is disabled will now display an "Action Blocked" popup on the HUD.
[/list]

[h2]PC-specific[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ray Tracing: Overdrive Mode - exits preview status and includes several image quality improvements.
[*] Introduced ReSTIR GI – Further improves path-traced lighting quality in RT: Overdrive mode, especially darker areas with no impact on performance, minimizes ghosting.
[*] DLSS Ray Reconstruction – now available in RT Ultra and other RT modes with RT Reflections enabled.
[*] Fixed an issue where V's and NPCs' skin could have a metallic-like effect when Ray Tracing was enabled.
[*] Fixed an issue where some characters' hair didn't cast shadows when Ray Tracing was enabled.
[*] Added support for DualSense controllers. If you experience issues with the game freezing on Steam when the controller is connected after the game is already launched, please make sure to change PlayStation Controller Support in Steam settings to "Not Enabled" instead of "Enabled" or "Enabled in Games w/o Support".
[*] Added support for Samsung HDR10+ GAMING for NVIDIA GPUs. To enable this feature, your display has to support the technology and have the "Game Mode" enabled. The HDR10+ GAMING toggle can be found in Settings in the Video tab.
[/list]

[h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash occurring when trying to reach the second sniper in Play It Safe.
[*] It will now be possible to properly interact with the radio in V's apartment in Megabuilding H10.
[*] Fixed an issue where there was still some deadzone after setting the Inner Dead Zone on a controller to 0.
[*] Added more secrets to be discovered by players in Night City.
[/list]

Hey chooms, remember that these are just the highlights! There are a lot of other improvements and fixes in this update, so make sure to check them out yourself tomorrow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210272/02c6293d76ba2ad8de9c370e1e188e38cf7095f3.gif[/img]

newsitems.title: Hotfix available
newsitems.author: Vattier
newsitems.contents:
A hotfix for Cyberpunk 2077 is out! It addresses crashes that happened when proceeding from start screen to main menu of the game.

The update won't change the version of the game visible in the main menu but might still affect mods.
